label: Season phase (tie-break layer)
_note: T2-sourced seasonal rig fits. The phase is derived deterministically from the report date (N. hemisphere: Mar-May spring, Jun-Aug summer, Sep-Nov fall, Dec-Feb winter). Only phases with sourced claims carry fits; every other phase is a null-safe no-op. Weighting: raw fit x 0.25, per-dimension cap ±0.5, total tie-break cap ±1.0 (kb/CONDITIONS.md). Magnitudes are the editorial translation of the cited claims; the quotes are the facts. One quote preserves the source's spacing before its comma (sic).
